title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 29B — Statutory provision (ACA s. 29B)

content.overview: Section 29B permits parties to agree in writing to a fast-track arbitration. The tribunal is constituted in the manner prescribed by the section, the proceeding is intended to be document-focused, and the award is subject to the statutory fast-track time limit and related procedural conditions.
